title: symphyotrichum lowrieanum
intro: Symphyotrichum lowrieanum, commonly known as Lowrie's aster or New England aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant is used in traditional herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum lowrieanum include its ability to reduce fever, ease pain, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
